text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian brilliantly conquers the 
Arima Kinen. Biwa Hayahide was overwhelmed 
by her sister's run and showered her with 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun declared outright that she 
would win next time. Biwa Hayahide echoed 
the sentiment. The challengers to her 
crown would never cease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is far from satisfied as 
well. Just imagining the next race and 
battles against the new generation makes 
her itch to run—
